answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-locked admission: an agent must lock collateral before attestations count, and voting weight accrues slowly, like sediment pressed into shale, so fresh accounts barely matter. Graders audit the whole orchard of daily tasks while long-term trust moves like a glacier, compounding across settled epochs. If two identities are proven to share one operator, both stakes are slashed and grading seats are lost. Attackers post real capital for every fake identity and forfeit it on detection, so sybil farming turns unprofitable.
